title: Viakifishi (Theme 8: Misukosuko ya kijamii)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child uses mabano for extra information or stage directions and the kistari kifupi for ranges, some compound words and a word broken at the line end.
steps: A range or compound? Kistari kifupi.

board.do: Mkutano utafanyika (saa nne ___ saa sita) ukumbini.
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "saa nne-saa sita" and one sentence with mabano.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni alama ipi huweka maelezo ya ziada?" Kwa nini "kistari kifupi" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Ni alama ipi inatumika kati ya tarakimu kama kurasa 5 hadi 10?" Kwa nini "mabano" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kistari kifupi hutumika kati ya tarakimu.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni alama ipi hutumika kuvunja neno mwishoni mwa mstari?" Kwa nini "koloni" si jibu sahihi?
Kuna masafa au neno ambatani hapa?

checks.question: Maelekezo ya jukwaa katika tamthilia huwekwa ndani ya?
